messages:
rosa-sales: Heads-up--prep for tomorrow's call with Meridian Bank. They need EU-only processing, BYOK, and explicit no-cross-border-failover. Can we give a short script + ops checklist?

ev an-presales: Short script: Hosted = preference; Dedicated/Private = pinning available with BYOK.

kevin-eng: Hosted: regional preference, not guaranteed under heavy load. Dedicated: can pin to a single EU region and disable inter-region fallback. Private: full control. BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private after KMS onboarding (key exchange + test decrypt).

may-legal: Subprocessors in EU: LogSafe, Observr, CloudGX. We can provide DPA + subprocessor attestation and SOC2 report. Avoid absolutist language for Hosted.

rosa-sales: Two conservative one-liners I can read?

kevin-eng: Hosted: "Redwood processes customer data in EU regions by default; in exceptional capacity events requests may be routed outside the region; Redwood will notify the customer and offer mitigation."

kevin-eng: Dedicated: "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region; data processing/storage will remain in that region except for necessary control-plane metadata."

rosa-sales: Ops timeline & cost notes?

sophie-pricing: Ballpark: setup ~$35k, committed monthly ~$16k for 2x A100, BYOK/attestation ~$4k/yr.

sam-ops: KMS onboarding 1-3 weeks; Private/on-prem adds 4-6 weeks. I'll open ticket PROJ-11078 with checklist: region selection, KMS key ID + allowlist, subproc attestation, egress certs, SLA items.

ops-bot: Ticket PROJ-11078 created and assigned to @sam-ops.

rosa-sales: Perfect, I'll use this on the call and post notes. :thumbsup:
